entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return an order. Number 774-B-912.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Let me just pull up that order number... 774-B-912. I see a Trail Helmet purchased on December 7th.
That's the one. Just tell me how to send it back.
I can definitely help with that. To make sure I process this correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference. The color is wrong. It's not what I expected. The box is still unopened.
I understand. Not a problem at all. Let me just check the policy for you... Okay, I see you received it nine days ago. You're well within our 90-day return window.

Yes, absolutely. We want to make sure you're happy with your gear, especially when it comes to safety. I'm processing the return now and I've just sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email on file. Is that correct?
Yes, that's my email. I'll look for it. Thanks.
You're welcome. Once we receive the helmet, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can help with?
